browser.source: hand-prepared Chrome 109 win32 archive (last Chrome line supporting Windows 7)
browser.note: Chrome 109 win32（最后一个支持 Windows 7 的 Chrome 版本）；archivePath 为空则跳过，包内不含浏览器；浏览器再分发合规性由投喂者自行确认

common.description: Slim Win7-friendly common package set with networking, office/video document IO, fonts, map/weather tooling, database access, and plotting.

notes: Python 3.8 is the last official CPython line that still supports Windows 7.
The embeddable package is used so the supplement archive can be extracted directly into the desktop install directory.
Windows 7 should include KB2533623 and the Universal CRT update for best compatibility.
The default Python package index is the Tsinghua Tuna mirror for more stable Win7 supplement builds in domestic networks; override it with -PythonPackageIndexUrl when needed.
The Playwright Python driver is pinned in requirements-win7-common.txt (a win32 wheel exists for CPython 3.8), but Chromium is NOT bundled: the Playwright Chromium build requires Windows 10+.

Playwright 1.16 and later bundle an x64 Node runtime even in their win32 wheels. The Win7 ia32 package stays on Playwright 1.15.2, whose win32 wheel has an i386 Node 12.20.1 driver, and validates that PE machine type before packaging.

The build never downloads a browser by itself (Playwright Chromium requires Windows 10+), but a hand-prepared Chrome 109 win32 archive can be staged into opt/browser via the top-level browser section or -BrowserArchivePath; whether the binaries may be redistributed is the feeder's own responsibility to confirm.
On Win7 the browser_* tools must drive a locally installed browser via mode/executable_path/channel; installBrowser stays false so the build never attempts to download Chromium.
To ship a modern browser for Windows out of the box, add a Windows 10+ x64 supplement with installBrowser=true; the Win7 ia32 pack tops out at Chrome 109.
Git for Windows documents 2.46.2 as the last version supporting Windows 7 / 8 / 8.1.
PortableGit ships Git Bash (bash) plus the POSIX toolchain (curl, tar, which, ssh, gzip, less, etc.) so the agent command tool runs in a bash environment.
The PortableGit archive is a 7-Zip self-extracting executable; the build script extracts it silently with -o<dir> -y.
ripgrep is bundled as a standalone binary so search_content can use rg without relying on system installation.
Static FFmpeg 4.4.1 (built 2021, i686-w64-mingw32, gcc 11.2) for Windows 7 compatibility.
Bundles x264, x265, aom, vpx, opus, mp3lame, webp, openjpeg and many other codecs; the gzip asset is decompressed into opt\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe during staging.
